title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-10-09
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT > CD; Transfer Info: CD > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard remaster with decent clarity and a standout Playing in the Band, though Grace Slick’s cameo feels under‑used.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds generally good but shows some hiss and high‑end compression artifacts; listeners still appreciate the clear mix of Jerry, Bob, Phil and Bill. Musically the show is respectable – “Playing in the Band” shines – but the overall performance is uneven, lacking the experimental spark typical of great Dead nights and featuring a guest blues number that many felt missed the mark.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality averages around good (≈3.5) with mixed remarks, while recording quality is slightly better (≈3.8). Weighted combination yields ~3.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Background hiss and compression artifacts on cymbals/high‑end frequencies noted; overall mix is praised as clear enough to hear all band members despite age‑related master issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally solid with sweet moments, but overall a bit sloppy and lacking the usual experimental daring; guest appearance feels under‑utilized.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mix allows clear hearing of Jerry’s guitar work throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Some criticism of Phil’s vocal contribution, especially on the Grace Slick blues number.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s rhythm guitar and vocals are audible and well‑balanced in the mix.
